sources.entry: Starcat - Native, local-first GitHub Stars manager that turns saved repositories into a searchable, AI-assisted knowledge base.

summary.one_liner: Starcat is a native macOS app (SwiftUI) that syncs your GitHub Stars into a local SQLite workspace and turns the repos you keep into a searchable, AI-assisted knowledge base.
keywords: ask questions about my starred repos
summary.what_it_does: Starcat signs in to GitHub with OAuth, incrementally syncs starred repositories, and caches them in a local SQLite database with FTS5 search. Users can add tags, private notes, reading status (Unread/Reading/Adopted/Deprecated), Smart Collections, and pinning, and can render READMEs including Mermaid diagrams. Repos the user ingests into a knowledge base feed a RAG workspace that answers questions with chunk-level citations, using keyword, embedding, and RRF retrieval. AI summaries, tag suggestions, notes, and repo chat use a bring-your-own key or self-hosted provider such as Ollama. The app also includes a GitHub notifications inbox, repo health and OpenSSF Scorecard views, release subscriptions, Explore and Trending discovery, and an embedded codebase analyzer (codebase-memory-mcp and CodeFlow). The README also lists companion CLI, MCP, browser, and launcher integrations that read the same local store.
use_cases: organize and search my GitHub stars
build a personal knowledge base of useful open-source projects
add notes and tags to starred repos
track reading status and releases of starred repos
share a starred repo via a public page
explore GitHub Trending and weekly picks on a Mac
how_to_run: Build from source: install Xcode 26+, run `brew install xcodegen`, copy Configs/Secrets.xcconfig.template, run `xcodegen generate`, then run the Starcat scheme
notable: Knowledge base is separate from GitHub Stars: only ingested repos enter search, summaries, and RAG
Chunk-level RAG citations that can point to a specific paragraph in a README or note
Local-first: tags, notes, and reading status stay in local SQLite; API keys stay in Keychain
Embedded analyzers for symbol-level knowledge graphs and architecture health checks of starred repos
Companion ecosystem of CLI, MCP, Agent Skill, browser extensions, and launcher plugins, plus self-hostable APIs
caveats: Requires macOS 15 or newer; the public Direct download is Apple Silicon only; no iOS, Windows, or Android builds
Official builds use App Store in-app purchase or a Direct license for Pro workflows and higher AI quotas; the license API is private
Building from source needs Apple Developer Program membership and Xcode 26+; some supporting repos are private and need org access
CloudKit sync fields are reserved and the production adapter is not wired yet; some features depend on optional self-hosted support APIs
